data.name: Gorga
data.long_meaning: The name Gorga is derived from the Greek word Γοργάς (Gorgas), which means 'earth-worker' or 'farmer'. In Greek mythology, Gorgon was a name given to a group of monstrous sisters with living serpents for hair. In the Bible, Gorgas is not mentioned directly, but the name could be inspired by the biblical figure Gideon, who threshed wheat in a winepress to hide from the Midianites.
